author: Kate King
title: Looking for character art for two pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced. Contact: comment below only, no DMs.

author: Maitespena
title: Seeking illustrators for book promo character art
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Contact: comment with portfolio and prices or DM.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂 See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍 Contact: see thread for details.
